capabilities: execute Clojure and ClojureScript code blocks in reading view
chain code blocks into data pipelines across a document
render interactive React components with Reagent
access the Obsidian API via window.app from note code
run the same code blocks on published web pages
extras: The README carries a prominent security warning: the plugin executes any Clojure code in the vault, which can harm the vault, Obsidian, or the whole system, so users should not paste untrusted code. Installation instructions and a demonstration vault (with a web version) live outside the README.
problem: Obsidian code blocks are inert; there is no way to run executable Clojure code directly inside a document and display its results.
summary: Code execution plugin that runs Clojure and ClojureScript code blocks in notes, chaining blocks into data pipelines and interactive Reagent UIs.
